Package com.blackbuild.annodocimal.ast

Class Documentation

java.lang.Object
com.blackbuild.annodocimal.ast.Documentation
@NullMarked public final class Documentation extends Object
An immutable, normalized documentation model for transformation authors. Instances preserve authored block and generic-tag order and expose immutable collections. Use toBuilder() to rewrite a value and render() to produce normalized carrier content.
